rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.mood: The CRT hums while rain traces the bedroom window.

hotspots.label: Beige computer
hotspots.text: Future doorway for scoped, local AI tools. There is no live model access in this demo.

hotspots.label: Cassette deck
hotspots.text: A future More Bounce radio could play here. The demo never autoplays audio.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.kicker: HOME IS WHERE THE FUTURE BEGINS
rooms.mood: Faded wallpaper, family photos, soft light under a mysterious door.

hotspots.label: Photo gallery
hotspots.text: A future place for owner-curated memories and preserved project artifacts.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.mood: Velvet couch, glowing television, and room for good conversation.

hotspots.label: Television
hotspots.text: Future shared stories and guest-approved conversations. No live guests are connected.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.mood: The refrigerator runs, a recipe card waits, coffee is always imaginary.

hotspots.label: Refrigerator
hotspots.text: A possible community bulletin board using owner-approved public material only.

rooms.name: Upstairs Den
rooms.mood: Paperbacks, a green reading lamp, and shelves full of things to discover.

hotspots.label: Bookshelf
hotspots.text: Future read-only library of personal, shared and published artifacts. All require separate permissions.

rooms.name: Basement Arcade
rooms.mood: CRT pixels, carpet and the glorious sound of quarters that never ran out.

hotspots.label: Arcade cabinet
hotspots.text: Future PhiCade and SPARK doorway. These games are not embedded in phase 0.

rooms.name: Garage Workshop
rooms.mood: An electronics workbench filled with promising unfinished experiments.

hotspots.label: Workbench
hotspots.text: Future OpenBlue, PixelForge and maker workflows through scoped integration.

rooms.name: Attic
rooms.mood: Old boxes, photographs, magnetic tape and little rediscoveries.

hotspots.label: Memory trunk
hotspots.text: Future copy-only archives and provenance ledgers; original files remain untouched.

rooms.name: Hall of Brothers
rooms.mood: A corridor that is much bigger inside than the house outside.

hotspots.label: Door crests
hotspots.text: Decorative sample worlds. AI provider authentication, autonomous travel and session continuity are not installed.

rooms.name: Back Porch
rooms.mood: The porch light glows; beyond the railing waits Midnight Sierra and the Commons.

hotspots.label: Mount Shasta view
hotspots.text: A visual metaphor for the separate Infinite Commons and Parallax Shasta world.

doors.label: Library of Stars
doors.world: A private imaginary world of books and constellations.

doors.label: Garden of What-If
doors.world: An illustrated garden where stories and ideas could grow.

doors.label: The Endless Workshop
doors.world: A future personalized place to sketch and collaborate.
